name: fievel
description: Build and improve a portable content system with guided workflows and local quality checks. Runs bundled Python tools on your computer, with your permission; requires Python 3.10+.

interface.longDescription: Build portable content systems: six guided skills and local tools. Hosted MCP provides lessons, templates, validation and saved-response checks. Validation sends package data to Fievel's Google Cloud server for in-memory processing; no content is stored. Local tools need Python 3.10+ and jsonschema.
defaultPrompt: Start Fievel and help me build my content system.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.0 adds hosted MCP tools for lessons, templates, package validation and saved-response checks. Validation sends supplied package data to Fievel's Google Cloud server for in-memory processing; no content is stored. Six guided skills and local Python tools remain available.
